properties.name_zh: 通用接口研发与验证用地
properties.accountable_role_zh: 规划、国土空间与法务（未来经授权）
properties.accountable_role_en: Planning, territorial spatial planning, and legal (future, authorised)
properties.rollback_state_zh: 本要素为概念对象（`official_boundary=false`、`evidence_status=concept_only`），不含任何已安装构件；撤回或替换只发生在文件层，不产生现场撤除动作。官方几何到位时整体替换，并按 EPSG:4548 重新复算全部关联读数。用地事项在包内一律卡在 G0：只在权属与用途条件已明确的地块提出可逆动作，临时几何不推定供地。
properties.rollback_state_en: A conceptual object (`official_boundary=false`, `evidence_status=concept_only`) carrying no installed component; withdrawal or replacement happens at file level and triggers no removal on site. When official geometry arrives the feature is replaced whole and every dependent reading recomputed in EPSG:4548. Land matters are held at G0 throughout this package: reversible actions are proposed only on parcels whose ownership and permitted use are already clear, and provisional geometry never implies land supply.
properties.next_review_trigger_zh: 取得官方地块、权属、用途管制与更新政策适用性资料，或 R-05 政策不确定性停止阈值成立（适用许可、官方资料、专业责任或开放边界缺失且现有证据不足以支持下一闸门）时立即复审。
properties.next_review_trigger_en: Reviewed as soon as official parcel, ownership, use-control and renewal-policy applicability material arrives, or R-05 policy uncertainty triggers — applicable permission, official material, professional accountability, or the opening boundary missing, with existing evidence insufficient for the next gate.
